Config {\n267\t    /// Load configuration from all three layers with Tier-0 defaults.\n268\t    ///\n269\t    /// Layer precedence (later layers override earlier ones):\n270\t    /// 1.       }\n490\t        }\n491\t\n492\t        Ok(())\n493\t    }\n494\t\n495\t    /// Check if `subcommand` is intercepted for `tool`.\n496\t    pub fn intercepts(&self, tool: &str, subcommand: &str)
